generation_method: codex CLI(사용자 ChatGPT 로그인)의 image_generation 도구, codex exec -m gpt-5.6-sol, 참조 그림은 -i로 첨부. 생성 PNG를 그대로 저장

assets.prompt:
Call your image_generation tool exactly once to create ONE image. The attached images are references: the first is the STYLE reference, follow its art style exactly. Do not copy their poses.

Game character art for a cute cat fantasy strategy game: ONE full-body cat warrior unit, the same character will be used as a board-game unit token and on a card, so it must read clearly even when shrunk to 72 px. Character: Shield Cat (cat warrior race). Look: the biggest, roundest cat of the army with a round barrel body, white fur with a few large irregular rounded black patches like a dairy cow (NOT stripes, NOT rings; legs and tail mostly white with at most one patch each), thick short legs, droopy sleepy eyes with heavy relaxed eyelids, calm not angry. Thick steel plate armor with gold trim and a crimson cloth tabard and short crimson cape. A huge rectangular steel tower shield with a gold rim and a simple gold crown emblem, almost as tall as the cat. He holds ONLY the tower shield: no sword, spear or any other weapon. Pose: a dynamic shield bash, the round body pushing forward behind the planted tower shield in a low sturdy stance, cape flaring back; the sleepy eyes look unbothered. Compact dynamic pose: the whole character with weapon fits inside the square canvas with margin, not a long horizontal stretch. Big head, about 35-40% of the body height, so the face reads at 72 px. Eye highlight: one small white dot at the upper LEFT of each pupil. No crown, gem or ornament on the forehead. Bold readable silhouette, the face clearly visible beside the shield, not hidden. Whole character and shield inside the canvas with a clear empty margin on all sides, nothing cut off. No ground, no floor, no cast shadow, no background, no scenery, no effects.
Clean indie flat vector illustration matching the style reference warrior exactly: angular faceted planes with straight hard edges, like folded paper or cut gems, two to four tones per material, single light source from the upper left. Bold dramatic silhouette, same body proportions and exaggeration as the reference. No rounded blobby shapes, no gradients, no texture, no grain, no noise, no glow, no blur, no black outlines, no whisker lines, no eyelashes. Crisp clean edges, fully transparent background. Simple eyes like the reference with one clear white highlight at the upper left. Smallest details at least 10 px wide. No text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark.

assets.edit_prompt:
Call your image_generation tool exactly once to EDIT the first attached image: keep it identical (pose, proportions, colors, composition, transparent background) except for the requested change. Any other attached images are style references only.

Change ONLY the eyes of this Flag Cat. Remove the thin dark eyelash flick strokes at the outer corners of both eyes and the thin dark crescent line inside the left eye beside the pupil. Each eye becomes a simple flat shape like the style reference: a cream eye shape, one solid dark brown pupil, and one small white highlight at the upper left of the pupil. Same eye size, position, direction and cheerful expression.
